rev.t: Had a pleasant experience buying a new helmet here. Staff was very helpful during the process and explained the details of each helmet patiently. One thing that I liked was they were not trying to stick their stock by making any false claims but genuinely tried to understand my usage and guided me along the process.

They know their stuff!!! Many products, many different features, yet they can explain every bit of every product with ease. Also biker talks just start off without you noticing :) WARNING: If you are fond of biker tales, be ready to spend …
Popular brands mid range helmet, riding gear from brands like Rynox, scala etc available. Good purchase experience.
